spl_product_data_elements: Calcium Carbonate 1000 mg Calcium Carbonate 1000 mg - Tropical Fruit STARCH, CORN FD&C YELLOW NO. 5 ALUMINUM LAKE FD&C RED NO. 40 ALUMINUM LAKE CALCIUM CARBONATE CALCIUM CATION ADIPIC ACID ANHYDROUS DEXTROSE MALTODEXTRIN SUCRALOSE FD&C YELLOW NO. 6 ALUMINUM LAKE MAGNESIUM STEARATE Tropical Fruit(Orange, Pineapple, Strawberry, Banana) (orange, yellow, red) T472
active_ingredient: Active ingredient (per tablet) Calcium Carbonate USP 1000 mg
indications_and_usage: Uses relieves heartburn acid indigestion sour stomach upset stomach associated with these symptoms
ask_doctor_or_pharmacist: Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are presently taking a prescription drug. Antacids may interact with certain prescription drugs.
when_using: When using this product do not take more than 7 tablets in 24 hours if pregnant do not take more than 5 tablets in 24 hours do not use the maximum dosage for more than 2 weeks, except under the advice and supervision of a doctor
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children.
dosage_and_administration: Directions adults and children 12 years of age and over: chew 2-3 tablets as symptoms occur, or as directed by a doctor. Chew or crush tablets completely before swallowing. do not take for symptoms that persist for more than 2 weeks unless advised by a doctor.
other_safety_information: Other information each tablet contains: elemental calcium 400 mg, magnesium 12 mg store at room temperature. Keep the container tightly closed.
inactive_ingredient: Inactive ingredients adipic acid, corn starch, dextrose anhydrous, FD&C red 40 Al lake, FD&C yellow #5 Al lake, FD&C yellow #6 Al lake, flavors, magnesium stearate, maltodextrin, sucralose
